S1:10.text: And a riuier iſſued out of the place of pleaſure to water Paradiſe, which from thence is divided into four heades.

S1:2.text: And the ſeuenth day God ended his woorke which he had made: & reſted the ſeuenth day, from al woorke that he had done.

S1:3.text: And he bleſſed the ſeuenth day and ſanctified it becauſe in it he had ceaſed from al his woorke which God created to make.

S1:4.text: Theſe are the generations of heauen & earth, when they were created in the day, when our Lord God made the heauen, and the earth.

S1:5.text: And euery plant of the filde, before it hot vp in the earth. And euerie herbe of the ground before it ſprang for our Lord God had not rayned vpon the earth and man was not to til the earth

S1:6.text: But a ſpring roſe out of the earth, watering al the ouermoſt part of the eartth.

S1:8.text: And our Lord God had :: planted a Paradiſe of pleaſure from the beginning wherin he placed man whom he had formed.

S1:9.text: And our Lord God brought forth of the ground al manner of trees, fayre to behold: and pleaſant to eate of: the tree of life alſo in the middle of Paradiſe: and the tree of knowledge of good & evil.

S3:10.text: And a riuier iſſued out of the place of pleaſure to water Paradiſe, which from thence is diuided into four heades.

S3:11.text: The name of the one is Phiſon: that is it which compaſſeth al the land of Heuilath, where gold groweth.

S3:3.text: And he bleſſed the ſeuenth day and ſanctified it becauſe in it he had ceaſed from al his woorke which God created to make

S3:4.text: Theſe are the generations of heauen & earth, when they were created in the day, when our Lord God made the heauen, and the earth.

S3:6.text: But a ſpring roſe out of the earth, watering al the ouermoſt part of the earth.

S3:8.text: And our Lord God had :: planted a Paradiſe of pleaſure & from the beginning wherin he placed man whom he had formed.

S3:9.text: And our Lord God brought forth of the ground al miner of trees, fayre to behold: and pleaſantto eate of: the tree of life alſo in the middle of Paradiſe: and the tree of knowledge of good & euil.

S6:2.text: And the ſeuenth day God ended his worke which he had made: and reſted the ſeuenth day, from al worke that he had done.

S6:3.text: And he bleſſed the ſeuenth day & ſanctified it: becauſe in it he had ceaſed from al his worke which God created to make.

S9:10.text: And a riuers iſſued out of the place of pleaſure to water Paradiſe, which from thence is diuided into four heades.

S9:11.text: The name of the one is Phiſon: that is it which compaſſeth al the land of Heuilath, where gold groweth.

S9:18.text: Our Lord God alſo ſaid It is not good for man to be alone let vs make him a helpe like vnto him ſelfe.

S9:19.text: Our Lord God therfore hauing formed of clay al beaſtes of the earth, and foules of the ayre, brought them to Adam that he might ſee what to cal them for al that Adam called any liuing creature, the ſame is his name.

S9:2.text: And the ſeuenth day God ended his woorke which he had made & reſted the ſeuenth day, from al woorke that he had done.

S9:20.text: And Adam called al beaſtes by their names, and al foules of the ayre, and al cattel of the filde but vnto Adam there was not found an helper like him ſelfe.

S9:21.text: Our Lord God therfore caſt a dead ſleepe vpon Adam and when he was faſt a ſleepe, he tooke one of. his ribbes, & filled vp fleſh for it.

S9:22.text: And our Lord God :: built the ribbe which he tooke of Adam into a woman and brought her to Adam.

S9:24.text: Wherfore man ſhal leaue his father & mother, & ſhal cleaue to his wife, & they ſhal be :: two in one fleſh.

S9:3.text: And he bleſſed the ſeuenth day and ſanctified it becauſe in it he had ceaſed from al his woorke which God created to make

S9:6.text: But a ſpring roſe out of the earth, watering al the ouermoſt part of the earth.

S9:8.text: And our Lord God had :: planted a Paradiſe of pleaſure from the beginning wherin he placed man whom he had formed.

S9:9.text: And our Lord God brought forth of the ground al maner of trees, fayre to behold and pleaſant to eate of: the tree of life alſo in the middle of Paradiſe: and the tree of knowledge of good & euil.
